newsitem.title: JAPAN: Low rate policy helping Japan's recovery--BOJ.
newsitem.headline: Low rate policy helping Japan's recovery--BOJ.

text.p: The Bank of Japan's (BOJ) current low interest rate policy is helping Japan's economic recovery, BOJ Governor Yasuo Matsushita told a parliamentary committee on Tuesday.
Matsushita said low interest rates have led to improvement in corporate earnings and thereby contributed to economic recovery.
"The low rate policy has increased corporate activity and is contributing towards the economy's self-sustaining recovery. We believe this is important," he said.
He stressed that low interest rates had in particular helped improve the earnings of smaller to medium-sized firms by lessening their interest rate payments.
